dedupe_keys.name: tallinn city open datasets on the estonian open data portal traffic restrictions real time public transport positions statistics

description: Tallinn City Government publishes its open datasets on the Estonian open data portal andmed.eesti.ee. The organisation listing read on 2026-09-28 shows 50 datasets, including traffic restriction open data (speed limits, mass limits, one-way streets and similar, modified on 10 June 2026), real-time public transport vehicle positions, the land operations information system MaTIS, the Tallinn statistics compendium, the 2023 city budget and registered outdoor advertising carriers. The real-time feed is a text file, gps.txt, giving for each trolleybus, bus, tram or night bus its line, WGS 84 coordinates, speed, heading and vehicle number, updated about every five seconds. Coverage is the city of Tallinn. Access is free; the portal says open data may be reused commercially and non-commercially under the licence set by each holder, and per-dataset licences were not read. Caveats: datasets vary in freshness, and several are administrative, not infrastructure data. It supports public transport and road network models, agent-based mobility simulation and city digital twins of Tallinn. Related record: data-estonia-road-register-teeregister gives the national road register that complements the city traffic restrictions.
licence: set per dataset (portal says open data may be reused under the licence set by the holder)
